newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African tax relief programme nets 300 mln rand.
newsitem.headline: S.African tax relief programme nets 300 mln rand.

text.p: South African tax defaulters have coughed up nearly three hundred million rand in unpaid dues since November last year, the South African Revenue Services (SARS) said on Monday.
It said in a statement that some 272.97 million rand had been collected from defaulters since government launched its tax relief programme in November last year.
SARS estimates that outstanding dues amount to 6.97 billion rand. Spokesman Christo Henning said the service expected to recover at least half of that amount.
"Realistically we expect to collect 4.3 billion rand if tax relief is one hundred percent succesfull, but we will be happy with 3.5 billion rand," Henning said.
